Ravi (People Ops): Hey team, urgent: pharmacist says they can accept digital card but the Rx BIN/PCN fields are blank in the mobile view.
Benefits Bot: Hi Ravi 44b The Benefits Portal has a downloadable ID PDF that includes Rx BIN/PCN. Go to https://benefits.redwood.com -> My Benefits -> Insurance Cards (SSO).
Tess M.: If the portal PDF still doesn't show BIN/PCN, check the subscriber dropdown 4dd sometimes it defaults to dependent view which hides pharmacy routing.
Chris J.: Pharmacist allowed override using name+DOB+employer (Redwood) and processed the script. They saved a claim ref in case of denial.
Ravi (People Ops): Thanks 44d Is there a quick way to get the BIN/PCN from benefits if PDF is missing?
Tess M.: DM me last 3 digits of your member ID and I'll verify with carrier. If claim later denies for routing, email benefits@redwood.com with the pharmacy claim reference and we will request carrier reprocess (usually takes 7-10 business days).
Benefits Bot: Reminder: new enrollments/changes can take up to 72 hours to appear on ID card PDFs.
Ravi (People Ops): Got it. Pharmacist accepted the override for now. Thanks, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
